title: Source: Bolts to cut Becton, save $9.7M on cap

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Source: Bolts to cut Becton, save $9.7M on cap
sources.description: The Chargers plan to release guard Mekhi Becton in a move that will save them $9.7 million against the salary cap, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
